text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The sunlight truly feels stronger 
than at the academy. However, just 5 more 
laps of running—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Heeey! Mac-chan! Let's do a crab-walk 
stamp rally! Or steel-plate menko is fine 
too, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-What is with that outfit meant purely 
for playing around?! The whole point of 
this training camp is to train, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We came all the way to the beach! There's 
a million other things we should be doing 
instead, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Like writing a poem in the sand 
reconciling quantum mechanics with general 
relativity! Or fighting over real estate 
with hermit crabs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, really now... Please save that sort of 
thing for after training is finished!
choice_data_list: Let's not get in McQueen's way.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's with you and McQueen~? Just what do 
you two think the ocean is!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... Now then, time for 30 dash 
reps—hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait, Gold Ship-san!? Are you all right!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
U-Uguu~...! G-Give me... water... and 
worms... pleaaase~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-If it's just water, I have some right 
here! Now, please drink up quickly!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whew... You are my lifesaver...! I must 
repay this debt somehow, yes I must...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Please, you simply must visit my "Castle 
Dragon Gol"... If you don't, I'll be stuck 
here forever, splitting invisible 
watermelons for all eternity...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What kind of curse is this?! Oh, fine... 
I'll go, all right?! I'll go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To think there's a place like this near 
the training lodge... And over there, a 
mountain of corn... and festival 
stalls...!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, 'cause it's the specialty of Dragon 
Gol Castle! First off, I'm gonna grill 
these up one after another!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I'd love to eat it, but... I mean, 
I really appreciate the thought, but if I 
eat too much, my training will suffer...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, but you don't get a say in this! 
You've already been dragged right into 
Ryu-Gol Castle's "Forced Hospitality 
Game"!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There's only one way home! You gotta clear 
every single hospitality event together 
with yours truly, Golshi-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. I was a fool for following 
along. Honestly, there's just no helping 
you—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Oh yeah! I cleared Ryugol Castle's 
traditional "Sea Bream Dance" with a full 
combo too~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*...! I couldn't tell which 
part of that was supposed to be Thailand, 
but... what is next?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Next up: "All-Bunker Golf"! Only "564 
kinds" of hospitality left! Sad to see it 
go, but we're finally reaching the grand 
finale!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This is not the climax at all!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's more than enough! If I do all of 
that, I really will end up like Urashima 
Taro!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, things are only just getting 
good from here on out! Come on back, 
Mac-cha~n!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaaawn*... Pheeew. What a refreshing 
morning it is—hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...What is this? A suspicious box outside 
the room... It says "Tamatebako" on it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff sniff*. Cake, donuts, pudding... 
T-They just smell like ordinary sweets—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Or so you thought! Except for one, these 
are Golshi's special 
spicy-sour-savory-sweet-bitter-astringent 
global-flavor balls... Now, McQueen, take 
on the challenge...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, Gold Ship-san! Hey! Hold on 
right there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, you there! Have you seen Gold 
Ship-san? For some reason, she's been 
pulling pranks non-stop since 
yesterday...!

...It seems the teasing continued even 
after parting ways yesterday. However, the 
reason for being so attentive is likely—
choice_data_list:
...In short, don't you just want someone 
to play with?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No way, all this just for that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...No, knowing Gold Ship-san, maybe that 
really is all there is to it...? If so, 
she really is quite the troublemaker...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you just want to play a little... 
No, I wonder. Spoiling you too much might 
not be good... Hmm...

"Still, letting Gold Ship run wild like 
this makes me anxious for all kinds of 
reasons. Should I just let her do what she 
wants, or try to calm her down here...?"
choice_data_list: Let's let Gold Ship play however she wants
Let's try our best to calm Gold Ship down.

text_block_list.text:
However, I didn't want to disrupt Mejiro 
McQueen's training either. So, I proposed 
the idea of a fun, playful joint training 
session to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship-san. There's a training routine 
I think you might like. Would you care to 
join me? The name is... well, you see—
choice_data_list:
It's the "High-Knee Conch Shell Harvesting 
Relay"!

It's the "High-Knee Conch Shell Harvesting 
Relay"!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Uhyoo! Is that the thing that took the 
West Coast by storm?! I'm in, I'm in, 
let's do thissss! Are we playing by Kanto 
or Kansai rules?!

—And so, Gold Ship seemed thoroughly 
pleased that she got to mess around with 
Mejiro McQueen to her heart's content.

"...However, in this case, someone needs 
to absorb her frustration. And that role— 
has to be mine!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you quite alright!? Taking on that 
Gold Ship all by yourself... Under such 
terms...!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, all right! Golshi-chan hasn't 
had her fill of summer yet! Next up is the 
Hula Hoop Seabed Stroll Festival!

...Just as Mejiro McQueen had worried, we 
ended up utterly exhausted... but somehow, 
Gold Ship seemed satisfied.
